_readme: Where the pre-2008 nea.com listing pages can be read, tried 2026-09-30 (COLLECTION.md s5: a channel tried and found empty is a finding).

internet_archive.detail: Machine-wide firewall cooldown set by other sessions at 11:42 (60 min), re-set at 12:43 for 120 min, and on this run's first query after it cleared IA refused the connection again (rc7): cooldown now at the 480-minute ceiling. One CDX year (1996) returned 0 rows seconds before the refusal and is recorded as unverified, not as an empty year.
internet_archive.ready: scratch/ia-cdx.py (1996-2012 CDX), scratch/ia-fetch.py (captures through ia_fetch), scratch/old-parse.py (ColdFusion SummaryReports incl. Historical and Public Purchase, ASP.NET CompanyDetail), scratch/old-roster.py

common_crawl.detail: 2008 on: the 2008-09 ColdFusion site (first page of each SummaryReport, the sector pages, NEATeam), the 2013 ASP.NET detail pages (338) and team table, and every /portfolio/<slug> and /team/<slug> page 2013-2026.

arquivo_pt.detail: CDX answers; nea.com holds 227 captures, all 2010-2011, the homepage and assets only (https://arquivo.pt/wayback/cdx?url=nea.com/*&from=1996&to=2012).
